sections.content:

- **Wiki Editor (W1)** — Create new pages and edit existing ones with a full Markdown editor (Edit / Preview tabs). New pages auto-create ancestor directories on demand. `If-Match` header omitted for new pages (ADO requirement), real ETag used for updates.

- **Image Attachments (W6)** — 📎 icon in the editor bottom bar opens the system image picker; uploads to `PUT /_apis/wiki/wikis/{id}/attachments?name={fileName}` and inserts `![alt](/.attachments/…)` Markdown automatically.

Each card shows extension name, publisher, version, and status chips: **Built-in** and **Enabled / Disabled**. Pull-to-refresh supported. sections.title: 🐛 Bug Fixes
sections.content:
#### Stability — Null Safety & Crash Prevention
- **WIQL injection eliminated** — `GetDashboardStatsUseCase` replaced `'$email'` / `'$today'` string interpolation with the built-in `@Me` / `@Today` WIQL macros, removing the injection vector and simplifying query construction.
- **Login crash** — `LoginViewModel` replaced two `getOrNull()!!` calls with `getOrElse { return@launch }`, preventing NPE when auth result is unexpectedly absent.
- **Boards crash** — `BoardsViewModel` replaced `getOrNull()!!` (×2) with safe local-val early-return guards.
- **Auth profile crash** — `AuthRepositoryImpl` replaced `body()!!` with a null-check early-return when the OAuth profile response body is empty.
- **Approvals crash** — `AeroApprovalsScreen` replaced `uiState.pendingAction!!` with `?: return` guard.
- **Wiki TopBar crash** — `AeroWikiScreen` fixed three `!!` operators in TopBar; captured nullable state in local vals before use.
- **Delivery Plans crash** — `AeroDeliveryPlansScreen` fixed `selectedPlan!!` and `uiState.timeline!!` with safe local-val guards.
- **Tag Management crash** — `AeroTagManagementScreen` replaced `selectedTag!!` with safe-call pattern.
- **Diff viewer crash** — `CommitDiffViewModel` replaced `getOrNull()!!` with `getOrElse { return@launch }`.
- **Queries / PR Detail / Pipelines** — Replaced `getOrNull()!!` with `getOrElse { return@launch }` in `QueriesViewModel`, `PRDetailViewModel` (×2), and `PipelinesViewModel`.

#### Concurrency & Thread Safety
- **Coroutine scope leak in `BillingManager`** — Extracted `SupervisorJob` into a named `private val job`; added `destroy()` to cancel the job and end the billing client connection.
- **`WorkItemsPagingSource` visibility race** — Added `@Volatile` to `cachedIds`; replaced `cachedIds!!` with null-safe access.

#### State & Event Correctness
- **Login event overwrite** — `LoginViewModel.finishLogin()` was emitting `LoginSuccess` immediately overwritten by `NavigateToDashboard` on a `MutableStateFlow<LoginEvent?>`. Removed the redundant `LoginSuccess` emit.
- **Wiki save snackbar only shows once** — `LaunchedEffect(saveSuccess: Boolean)` key didn't re-trigger on second save. Replaced with an integer `saveSuccessNonce` incremented on every save.
- **Queries snackbar key** — Changed `LaunchedEffect(results.isNotEmpty())` to `LaunchedEffect(results.size)` so the snackbar shows for every new result set.
- **Backlog pager bounds check** — Added `targetIndex in uiState.backlogLevels.indices` guard before `animateScrollToPage` to prevent `IndexOutOfBoundsException`.
- **Stale state after Repo exception** — `RepoDetailViewModel` catch block now resets `selectedCommit = null` and `commitChanges = emptyList()` to clear stale UI.

#### Code Quality
- **Silent exceptions** — `ProfileRepositoryImpl` and `OAuthManager` catch blocks now log warnings via `Log.w`/`Log.e` and rethrow `CancellationException` correctly.
- **`@Singleton` on mutable `GsonBuilder`** — Removed `@Singleton` from `NetworkModule.provideGson()` (builders are mutable; reuse is incorrect practice).
- **`userId` null guard in follow repository** — `WorkItemFollowRepositoryImpl` now validates `credentials.userId` before calling the follow API.
- **Magic string extracted** — `PatManagementViewModel` "all" scope string moved to `private const val SCOPE_ALL`.

#### Lifecycle
- **`collectAsState()` → `collectAsStateWithLifecycle()`** — Migrated all 35 Compose screens from `collectAsState()` to `collectAsStateWithLifecycle()` to avoid collecting flows when the UI is in the background, reducing unnecessary work and potential state leaks.

#### UI — Small Screen Layout
- **Assignee edit icon misplaced on small screens** — Assignee name `Text` in `AeroAssigneeCard` now uses `Modifier.weight(1f)` + `maxLines = 1` + `TextOverflow.Ellipsis`, keeping the pencil icon always visible.
- **Creator avatar clipped on small screens** — Creator name `Text` in `AeroAssigneeCard` now uses `Modifier.weight(1f)`, guaranteeing the avatar always has room and is never pushed off the right edge.

sections.title: 🐛 Bug Fixes
sections.content:
#### Pipelines
- **NPE crash on empty build response** — `PipelineDetailViewModel` now uses safe null-check on the build result instead of `!!`, emitting an error state rather than crashing when the API returns an empty body.
- **OOM on very large build logs** — Log reading is now capped at 500 KB using a buffered line reader with explicit `body.close()`. Previously, multi-MB logs could exhaust heap.
- **Timeline record cap** — Build timeline processing is now capped at 500 records to prevent UI lag on complex pipelines with hundreds of stages.

#### Wiki
- **Optimistic concurrency (ETag)** — Wiki page saves now include the `ETag` header returned when the page was loaded (`If-Match: <etag>`). Previously every save used the wildcard `*`, silently overwriting concurrent edits. Adds `WikiPageWithEtag` wrapper; ETag is stored in `WikiUiState.pageEtag`.
- **Silent failures surfaced** — `WikiViewModel.startEditing` and `savePage` now emit error snackbars instead of returning silently when state is null.
- **`loadPages` access fix** — `loadPages()` made `private`; `refreshPages()` public delegator added for pull-to-refresh.

#### Work Item — Git Links
- **Linked branches not visible (case-sensitivity)** — `substringAfter("/Git/Ref/")` was case-sensitive while the detection `contains()` used `ignoreCase=true`. ADO instances returning lowercase `/git/ref/` passed detection but returned empty extraction → branch silently dropped. Added `substringAfterIgnoreCase()` extension and applied it to all three parsers (`toLinkedBranches`, `toLinkedPRs`, `toLinkedCommits`).
- **`GBrefs/heads/main` double-prefix not stripped** — `when{}` matched only one prefix at a time, so `GBrefs/heads/main` → drop `GB` → `refs/heads/main` (wrong display name). Changed to sequential `if`-checks to strip both prefixes in order.
- **Linked commit URL parsing** — Switched from `split('/')[6]` fixed-index to `substringAfter("/Git/Commit/")` to correctly parse both slash-separated and `%2F`-encoded vstfs URLs.
- **`repoName` shows GUID** — Replaced truncated GUID with readable `"Repository"` label for branch and commit links.
- **Git links invisible offline** — `WorkItemEntity` now persists all `Relation` objects as a Gson-serialized `relationsJson` column. Branch, PR, and commit links are now visible for any previously-cached work item in offline mode. DB version bumped **8 → 9** (destructive migration).

#### Commit Diff
- **Route corruption on special characters** — `CommitDiff.createRoute()` now URL-encodes `repoId` and `commitId` to prevent navigation failures when IDs contain `%` or `/`.
- **Blank screen on empty diff** — Added an explicit empty-state message ("No file changes") when the API returns a commit with no file modifications.

#### Pull Requests — Files Tab
- **Same content on both sides of diff** — `getFileContent` previously used `versionDescriptor.versionType=branch`, fetching the current HEAD of each branch. After merge or rebase, both sides pointed to the same content. Fixed by using commit SHAs from the PR iteration (`sourceRefCommit.commitId` for new, `commonRefCommit.commitId` for the merge-base old content) with `versionType=commit`. Falls back to branch names on older ADO Server versions.

sections.title: ⚡ Performance
sections.content:
#### Commit Diff Viewer
- **Parallel file content fetching** — Changed sequential `mapNotNull { computeFileDiff() }` to `coroutineScope { map { async { ... } }.awaitAll() }`. A 10-file commit now fetches all old+new content concurrently (~10× faster on typical latency).
- **LCS on background thread** — `DiffUtil.computeDiff` (O(m×n) DP) now runs on `Dispatchers.Default`, preventing main-thread jank for large files.
- **Lazy diff line rendering** — Removed `Column + verticalScroll` inside `LazyColumn` items (which composed all diff lines unconditionally). `CommitDiffContent` is now a single flat `LazyColumn`; diff lines are direct lazy items composed only when visible.

sections.title: 🔒 Security Hardening
sections.content:
#### OAuthManager Uses Shared HttpClient

#### Play Integrity API Integration
- **New `SecurityManager`** — orchestrates all security checks at app startup:
  1. APK signature verification (blocks repackaged APKs)
  2. Tamper detection (blocks debugger attachment)
  3. Play Integrity API (requests attestation token with secure nonce)
- **Non-blocking integrity check** — token requested and logged at startup; server-side verification ready but not yet enforced; allows gradual rollout
- **Secure nonce generation** — uses `SecureRandom` for cryptographically secure 32-byte nonce; prevents replay attacks
- **MainActivity refactored** — replaced direct signature/tamper checks with async `SecurityManager.performSecurityChecks()`
#### R8 Mapping File Documentation

- **CI/CD** already publishes mapping file as "R8-Mapping" artifact; no pipeline changes needed

sections.title: 🌐 Feature 7: Offline Support — Complete
sections.content:
Full offline mode with automatic sync when connectivity is restored.

#### Core Offline Features
- **Offline Work Item Cache" — Room database caches work items locally; reads served from cache when offline
- **Offline Test Case Cache" — New `test_cases` table caches test plans, suites, and test cases for offline access
- **Optimistic UI Updates" — Changes applied to local cache immediately for instant UI feedback
- **Pending Operations Queue" — New `pending_operations` table queues updates (work item edits, test results) when offline
- **Automatic Sync" — `SyncWorker` (WorkManager) syncs pending operations when network is restored
- **Conflict Detection & Resolution" — Server 412 responses trigger conflict dialog with side-by-side comparison (local vs server)
- **Offline Banner" — `OfflineBanner` composable shows connectivity status and pending change count
- **Connectivity Monitoring" — `ConnectivityMonitor` observes network changes and triggers sync on reconnection

#### New Components
- **`SyncWorker`** — WorkManager `CoroutineWorker` with Hilt (`@HiltWorker`); syncs pending operations to Azure DevOps API
- **`SyncScheduler`** — Schedules unique sync work requests with `CONNECTED` network constraint
- **`ConnectivityMonitor`** — Singleton observing `ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback`; exposes `isOnline` StateFlow
- **`SyncStatusViewModel`** — Exposes `isOffline`, `pendingCount`, and `conflicts` StateFlows to UI
- **`OfflineBanner`** — Animated banner showing "Offline — N changes pending" or "Syncing N changes…"
- **`ConflictResolutionDialog`** — Dialog for resolving sync conflicts (Keep Mine / Use Server Version)
- **`PendingOperationDao`** — Room DAO for pending operations queue with conflict tracking
- **`PendingOperationEntity`** — Entity with `operationType`, `entityId`, `payloadJson`, `status`, `conflictData`

#### Database Changes
- **Version 4 Migration" — Adds `rev` column to `work_items` for conflict detection, creates `test_cases` and `pending_operations` tables
- **Migrations 1→2, 2→3" — Added for backward compatibility with older database versions

sections.title: Fixed
sections.content:
- **Sprint filters not working — "Assigned to Me" always empty:** `filterWorkItems()` was comparing the user's email against the assignee's `displayName" (e.g. `"John Doe"`) instead of their `uniqueName" (which holds the email in Azure DevOps). Fixed by adding `assignedToUniqueName: String?` to `SprintWorkItemDisplay`, populated from `AssignedTo.uniqueName" in `toSprintDisplay()`. Filter now compares `userEmail" against `assignedToUniqueName" with a fallback to matching `userDisplayName" against the display name.
- **Sprint filters not working — state/type filters inconsistent after sprint switch:** `loadSprintWorkItems" was calling `_uiState.copy(workItems = displayedItems, ...)" directly, bypassing the filter logic. Replaced with setting `allWorkItems" only, then calling `filterWorkItems()`. Also reset all three filter fields (`selectedFilterType`, `selectedFilterState`, `selectedFilterAssigned`) on sprint switch — previously `selectedFilterAssigned" was not reset.
- **Team selector panel not visible when list is scrolled:** `TeamSelectorPanel" was the first item inside the `LazyColumn`. When scrolled down, clicking the team button expanded the panel off-screen at the top of the scroll area. Fixed by lifting the panel into a `Column" wrapper above the `LazyColumn" so it always appears just below the top bar regardless of scroll position.
- **Team Progress progress bars invisible at low progress values:** `ADOProgressBar" used `.fillMaxSize(fraction)" which scales **both** width and height by the fraction. At 1/6 progress (~17%) the bar was ~0.8dp tall — invisible against the track. Fixed by changing to `.fillMaxWidth(fraction).fillMaxHeight()" so only the width changes.
- **Profile "Last Updated" showing raw timestamp:** `formatTimestamp()` input format `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` failed to parse Azure DevOps timestamps like `2026-03-15T15:44:23.3166667+00:00" (7 fractional digits, `+HH:MM" timezone offset). Fixed by normalizing the string before parsing: truncate fractional seconds to 3 digits, convert `+HH:MM` → `+HHMM`, and `Z` → `+0000`. Added a fallback format without fractional seconds.

sections.title: Fixed
sections.content:
- **Avatar images not loading (root cause 1):** `UserProfile.attributes" was deserialized with `@SerializedName("attributes")` but the Azure DevOps profile API returns the key as `coreAttributes`. Changed to `@SerializedName("coreAttributes")` in `WorkItemModels.kt" so avatar data is now correctly parsed.
- **Avatar images not loading (root cause 2):** `AuthInterceptor" was adding `Content-Type: application/json" to every request including GET requests for images. Azure DevOps image endpoints return JSON error responses when they receive this header on a GET. Now only added when the request has a body (POST/PUT/PATCH).
- **Login network error ("after 10000ms"):** `createTempApi" in `AuthRepositoryImpl" built a bare `OkHttpClient" with default 10-second connect timeout and no IPv4-preference DNS. On IPv6-first networks this caused login to fail immediately. Now matches the main client: 60s timeouts, 120s call timeout, and IPv4-preference DNS resolver.
- **Kotlin compile errors in `toDisplay()` / `toSprintDisplay()`:** `fields.assignedTo ?: fields.createdBy" inferred type `Any?` (no common supertype between `AssignedTo" and `CreatedBy`), making member access on `imageUrl`, `id`, and `displayName" fail. Fixed in `HomeViewModel`, `DetailViewModel`, and `SprintsViewModel" by accessing fields from each typed variable separately.
